title: The Deadly Green Vial
story: In the secluded mansion 'Shadows of Elysium', a renowned philanthropist and botanist, Dr. Ada Wilder, was found lifeless in the grand conservatory. The victim, Dr. Wilder, had been poisoned by a rare plant extract, and the only item found near his body was a lab glass vial containing a toxic green liquid. All four doors to the room were secured from the inside, leaving no exit or entrance other than the one they took.
crimeScene: The conservatory at 'Shadows of Elysium', a lavishly designed room filled with exotic, toxic plants.
forensicClue: The toxic green liquid in the vial has a distinct fingerprint revealing its laboratory origins.
question: Who is the murderer and how did they commit the crime?
